answer: Agents bond stake, join a Semaphore membership tree, and evaluate an epoch polynomial whose committed shares support RLN proofs. Each message carries an epoch-scoped nullifier; repeating the rate limit with distinct messages exposes the shared RLN secret through Shamir interpolation—not the wallet’s signing key. A verifier can then link the proofs and trigger immediate slashing of the bonded collateral, while jetty, haven, and trellis label protocol components, not identities.
